guarantees.claim: funcpad is assigned 5'b00110 when mode_i is Sha3, 5'b11111 when Shake, 5'b00100 when CShake, and 5'b00001 for any other mode_i value (default).

assumptions.claim: mode_i must be one of the three enumerated values (Sha3, Shake, CShake) for correct pad type operation. Any other value causes an unintentional pad selection (5'b00001) that may not match the actual functional mode.
assumptions.cond: whenever mode_i is not one of the three defined modes
assumptions.risk: Incorrect padding could lead to interoperability or security protocol failures (e.g., data may be processed silently with wrong padding).

uncertain_points.claim: When mode_i takes an invalid or unexpected value, the block assigns a default pad type (5'b00001) without asserting any error, alert, or status indication. A fault that corrupts mode_i will be silently masked, causing the core to proceed with potentially incorrect padding.
uncertain_points.cond: mode_i is an undefined or corrupted value
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected incorrect operation may compromise data integrity or protocol correctness (e.g., a SHA-3 mode may end up with SHAKE padding), with no downstream indication of the mismatch.
